notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Sphinx's Disciple, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
